title: Motorcycle OBD-II Telemetry Engine Temperature Leaderboard
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obd:bike coolant_temp_c=*
| stats sum(coolant_temp_c) as total_value, avg(coolant_temp_c) as avg_value by bike_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks bike values by total and average engine temperature across motorcycle OBD-II telemetry events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `coolant_temp_c` values for each motorcycle OBD-II telemetry event and review total and average engine temperature by bike.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total engine temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which bike shows the biggest engine temperature numbers in your motorcycle OBD-II telemetry data.
